display.purpose: Landing page hero headline only. Never in the app shell.

headline.purpose: Page titles (one per screen), major landing section headers.

title.purpose: Card titles, modal headings, named entity names in the product.

body.purpose: All readable prose. Max line length 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Form field labels, section eyebrows, table headers, metadata. Always uppercase with 0.07em tracking.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default card state. Barely visible — establishes a surface without drawing attention.

shadows.name: hover
shadows.purpose: Clickable cards on hover. Used alongside border shift to teal-mid (#c0e4e2).

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Modals, dropdowns, elevated panels. The only dramatic shadow in the system.

shadows.name: teal-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button hover only. Warm teal tint — not a generic blue glow.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions. Exponential ease-out — settles quickly, never bounces.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Color and border transitions on interactive elements (button hover, input focus).

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Shadow and opacity transitions on cards and overlays.

motion.name: duration-enter
motion.purpose: Modal and overlay entrance. Combine with translateY(12px) → translateY(0) + opacity 0 → 1.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Used for the single primary action on any surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 13px 26px; background: #1d7874; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #156360; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -4px rgba(29, 120, 116, 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d7874; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Always paired alongside a primary — never used alone as the only CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 13px 26px; background: transparent; color: #403a34; border: 1.5px solid #e5e0d8; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f4f0e8; border-color: #ccc7bd; color: #1a1510; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d7874; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input

narrative.overview:
Not a cold data terminal. Not a flashy startup dashboard. Calendio's visual system should feel like a well-run service business reception — warm, unhurried, completely in order. A salon owner opens the app and feels immediately reassured, not impressed. Confidence here comes from clarity and warmth, not from dramatic accents or clever animation.

The palette moves from cold slate-and-blue toward warm cream neutrals anchored by a single deep warm teal. Page backgrounds are warm off-white rather than sterile. Card borders have a cream cast. Shadows are tinted brown, not blue-black. The primary accent is not a generic SaaS blue — it is a purposeful teal that reads as calm and capable without raising its voice.

This system explicitly rejects the Supabase pattern: dense controls, multiple competing panels, developer vocabulary that intimidates a small-business owner. It also rejects the generic SaaS dashboard reflex — metric tiles in a grid, blue-to-violet gradients as decoration, gradient text on headlines, floating accent colors fighting for attention everywhere.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white page background, never cold slate
Single warm-teal accent held to ≤15% of any surface
Shadows are warm and diffuse, tinted brown not blue-black
Motion is quiet — state feedback only, no choreography
Typography hierarchy through weight contrast, not multiple typefaces
All copy is calm and direct; no exclamation marks, no startup energy

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: teal (#1d7874) appears on ≤15% of any given screen. It marks what the user should act on or notice — nothing else. Multiple teal accents competing on the same view is a failure state.

rules.name: The Warm Ground Rule
rules.body: No surface or background uses a cold-tinted neutral. The entire cold Tailwind slate scale (#f8fafc, #e2e8f0, #94a3b8, #0f172a) is retired. Every neutral in this system derives from warm-bg and shifts toward warm-ink.

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: No gradients used as decoration. No blue-to-violet CTA banners. No background-clip: text gradient headlines. Solid teal or solid warm-ink — these are the only fills a headline or button ever needs.

rules.name: The No-Italic Rule
rules.body: This system has no italic styles. Emphasis is weight (700 vs 500) or Label-style ALL CAPS. Italics signal uncertainty or informality — neither belongs in a product that earns trust by being steady.

rules.name: The Weight Bridge Rule
rules.body: Any two adjacent text levels must differ by at least one full weight step (800→700 or 700→500). A flat-weight page where everything is font-weight: 600 has no hierarchy.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow color is always derived from warm-ink (rgba(25, 21, 16, ...)). Cold blue-black shadows conflict with the warm ground. If someone could sample the shadow color and identify Tailwind slate, it's wrong.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A shadow on a non-interactive, non-elevated surface is decoration, not affordance. Remove it. Shadows are earned by state or structural role — never applied to make a card feel 'more card-like.'

dos: Do use warm-bg (#faf8f4) as the outermost page background.
Do keep teal (#1d7874) to ≤15% of any screen.
Do use warm shadows exclusively: rgba(25, 21, 16, ...) derived from warm-ink.
Do use Label typography for form labels, section eyebrows, and metadata.
Do shift only the border color for focus states — teal on focus, status-error on validation failure.
Do keep motion to state transitions only. Easing: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Duration: 120–160ms.
donts: Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a multi-stop gradient). One of the most identifiable AI-generated UI signals.
Don't use #2563eb (electric blue) or #7c3aed (violet). Both retired.
Don't use cold Tailwind slate neutrals: #f8fafc, #e2e8f0, #94a3b8, #64748b, #0f172a.
Don't build metric grids with oversized numbers and small labels — the hero-metric template is a SaaS cliché.
Don't use blue-to-violet gradient section backgrounds.
Don't use border-left colored stripes on cards or list items.
Don't let the product feel like Supabase: dense sidebars, developer vocabulary, competing panels.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, padding, top, left).
Don't use bounce or elastic easing.
